search_notes: Novocure topline press release (8-K exhibit 99.1) of 2 Dec 2024: PANOVA-3 met OS, mOS 16.20 vs 14.16 mo, HR 0.819, p=0.039, no CI given. CI (HR 0.82, 95% CI 0.68-0.99) first seen in the JCO paper / ASCO 2025 presentation on 2025-05-31 (PMID 40448572).

GSK headline-results RNS (filed as 6-K) of 20 Dec 2024: FIRST-ENGOT-OV44 met PFS, OS key secondary not significant, no numbers. HR first shown at ASCO 2025 (LBA5506); sources disagree whether the session was 1 or 2 June 2025, earliest coverage opened is dated 2 June; same HR later posted on ClinicalTrials.gov (2025-12-31).

Akeso HKEX voluntary announcement of 7 Nov 2023: AK104-302 (COMPASSION-15) met OS at a prespecified interim analysis, no numbers; this is 13 months before the registry "actual" primary completion date. HR 0.62 (0.50-0.78) first shown at AACR 2024 (CT006; AACR release and OncLive coverage dated 7 Apr 2024); the Nature Medicine paper (2025-01-22) reports HR 0.66 (0.54-0.81).

ANCHOR, ASCO 2025 LBA3502 (session may have been 30 May; coverage opened is dated 31 May); a Sino Biopharm HKEX notice of 24 Apr 2025 only listed the abstract title. CONFLICT: ASCO coverage reported non-inferiority as met (margin HR 1.09), but the 2026 publication (Signal Transduct Target Ther, PMID 42675036, 2026-09-01) states the trial failed to reach the prespecified non-inferiority margin (upper CI 1.18); recorded as not_met.

No result found by NCT, SMT-NK, SMT bio in English or Korean; registry record not updated since Sept 2022 (status unknown). A Dailypharm interview of 2026-09-16 says the phase 2b is ongoing (70 of 128 completed, descriptive interim ORR 28.6% only) with completion expected around Apr-May 2027.

Disclosed only as two sentences inside the GSK Q1 2025 results announcement of 30 Apr 2025 ("In April 2025, results showed that ZEAL-1L did not meet its primary endpoint of PFS"); no stand-alone press release found. First numeric HR found is the ClinicalTrials.gov results posting of 2026-05-01; journal paper followed (J Thorac Oncol, epub 2026-07-10). No conference presentation found.

AGO-OVAR 2.29/ENGOT-ov34 final results at ASCO 2024 (LBA5501; coverage dated 2 June 2024, exact session day within the meeting not confirmed): neither co-primary endpoint met. HR columns give OS; PFS HR 0.87 (0.73-1.04). Registry lists primary completion as 2025-03-11, nine months after the presentation; JCO paper 2025-12-03.

Not read out. TYK Medicines 2026 interim report (HKEX, Sept 2026) says the registrational phase 3 in EGFR L858R NSCLC had 548 patients enrolled by Apr 2026, enrolment to finish Q4 2026, NDA expected 2028. The 2025-2026 head-to-head-vs-osimertinib news concerns a different trial (phase 2 ESAONA, NCT05948813); registry record stale since Jan 2024.

Only disclosure found is one line in the Ascletis 2025 interim results (HKEX, 15 Aug 2025): "After analysis of ASC40 Phase III study for rGBM, the Group decided to terminate this program" - implies a negative outcome but states no endpoint result. The 2024 annual results (26 Mar 2025) said only that the group would "seek opportunities to maximise value". Lag computed from mid-month (registry PCD is month-only, 2025-06); registry not updated since Oct 2024.

BMS press release of 15 Dec 2023 (Business Wire 20231215733992, blocked to scripts; content read via TargetedOnc and OncLive): RELATIVITY-123 discontinued for futility after a planned IDMC analysis. This is 19 months before the registry primary completion date. First numeric HR found is the registry results posting of 2026-08-26 (all randomised 0.98; CPS>=1 1.09, 0.87-1.38); no conference presentation found.

REMARK interim analysis presented as late-breaking oral OA09.03 at WCLC 2024 on 9 Sept 2024 (Chinese-language coverage opened is dated 10 Sept 2024; Fosun English news item only on 2025-03-10 with the NMPA filing). Trial was registered on ClinicalTrials.gov only in Aug 2024, weeks before the readout, and lists 13 "primary" outcomes; the registry record is stale. An earlier abstract release or Chinese exchange notice is possible but not found.

No result found by NCT, AK104-307, or cadonilimab vs tislelizumab in PD-L1-negative NSCLC; Akeso reported first patient dosed in Mar 2024 and its 2026 interim results release does not mention a readout. Registry still says "not yet recruiting" (last update Aug 2023).

Pfizer topline press release of 14 Oct 2025: HER2CLIMB-05 met PFS, no numbers. HR first public with the SABCS 2025 presentation and simultaneous JCO paper on 10 Dec 2025; registry results posted 2026-09-29.

Phase 3 stage of ASTRUM-015 not read out: Henlius 2026 interim results release (Aug 2026, seen in search summary only) says phase 3 enrolment is complete, with no readout. Only the phase 2 part has been published (ASCO GI/ASCO 2024, Med 2024). Registry record stale (recruiting, last update Oct 2024).

No result found by NCT, MRG002-010, MRG002 urothelial in English or Chinese; Lepu Biopharma 2026 interim results (seen in search summary only) describe the phase 3 in urothelial carcinoma as ongoing. Registry record not updated since Apr 2023.

Sichuan Biokin (SSE 688506) announcement reported 18 Nov 2025 08:43 (may have been filed the previous evening): BL-B01D1-305 met both PFS and OS at a prespecified interim analysis, no numbers; Chinese-language only. HR columns give PFS by BICR from ASCO 2026 abstract coverage dated 25 May 2026; CIs (PFS 0.40-0.63; OS HR 0.64, 0.49-0.83) are in the SystImmune/BMS release at the 1 June 2026 oral.

Immunome topline press release (8-K exhibit) of 15 Dec 2025, 12 days after registry primary completion: RINGSIDE Part B met PFS. Drug renamed from AL102 to varegacestat and sponsor changed from Ayala to Immunome, so searches on the registry names miss it.

which_endpoint: PFS (co-primary with OS; OS immature at first disclosure)
search_notes: Roche release of 11 May 2022 (Genentech version dated 10 May US time): PFS co-primary not met at first analysis, OS immature. HR COLUMNS ARE FOR OS, NOT PFS: the first numeric HR was the second interim OS (0.81) that Roche published on 23 Aug 2023 after an inadvertent leak; PFS HR 0.78 (0.63-0.97) and final OS HR 0.87 (also not significant) came only at AACR 2025 / JCO 2026 (PMID 42507968). Registry PCD (2025-12-30) is 3.6 years after first disclosure.

Disclosed inside Philogen Q3 2025 financial press release dated 11 Nov 2025 (Euronext Milan regulated information): FIBROSARC did not meet PFS at final analysis (mPFS 7.9 vs 4.6 mo, 92 events), no HR given because proportional hazards did not hold. No numeric HR found since; registry status "unknown", last updated Apr 2024.

Dizal PR Newswire topline release datelined Shanghai 21 Mar 2026 (read via a syndicated copy): WU-KONG28 met PFS, no numbers. HR first public on 29 May 2026 with ASCO 2026 LBA8500 and simultaneous NEJM paper. Registry uses code name DZD9008.

Pfizer topline release of 12 Mar 2024: ECHELON-3 met OS at a prespecified interim analysis, no numbers; HR in the Pfizer release of 1 June 2024 for ASCO LBA7005, JCO paper Jan 2025. Registry primary completion date (2026-01-23) is 22 months after the readout, so the lag is strongly negative.

No sponsor press release found. Registry flipped to "Terminated - sponsor decision" on 2026-02-23; the only explanation found is a Fierce Biotech article of 22 Apr 2026 in which a Novartis spokesperson confirmed ASTER was halted after a data review suggested abelacimab would fail to beat apixaban. Which endpoint drove the stop is not stated, and an earlier mention in Novartis quarterly documents is possible but was not found.

AstraZeneca high-level results announcement (RNS, filed as 6-K) of 2 Apr 2026: EMERALD-3 met PFS at a planned interim analysis, no numbers. HR in the AstraZeneca release of 1 June 2026 for ASCO LBA4000; Lancet Oncology paper followed.

INTerpath-007 terminated for "business reasons" with 46 patients enrolled in the phase 2 part; the phase 3 part never ran, so there is no primary EFS analysis. Registry showed completed on 2026-03-25 and terminated on 2026-05-06; trade press reported the wind-down in Oct 2025 (paywalled, not opened). No Merck or Moderna release found.

which_endpoint: PFS by IRC (0-prior-chemo and overall populations)
search_notes: First disclosure is a Hengrui SSE announcement (no. 2026-092, dated 2 Jul 2026, Chinese only) that the NMPA accepted the HER2-low breast cancer filing; it states the phase 3 vs investigator-choice chemotherapy significantly prolonged PFS, with no numbers. The notice does not give the protocol number - matched to SHR-A1811-III-306 by design, comparators and population. No HR or conference presentation found yet.

BeOne (formerly BeiGene) topline press release of 30 June 2026 (Business Wire 20260630413578, blocked to scripts; read via CancerNetwork and a wire repost) gave the HR with CI and p-value. Full data to be presented later.

Only disclosure found is the ClinicalTrials.gov record: status changed to Terminated with reason "Lack of Efficacy, no safety concern" (submitted 2026-06-22, posted 2026-06-25). No Polaris press release, Taiwan exchange notice or conference abstract found in English or Chinese; an earlier Taiwan-exchange material-information notice is possible.

Not read out: registry updated 2026-10-07 still shows recruiting, and the primary completion date has moved from the 2026-06 in the input file to 2028-03 (estimated). No results found for glufosfamide phase 3; trial has been open since 2013.

No result found by NCT, HS-20117-301 or drug names; registry shows recruiting (last update Aug 2025) with study completion in 2030. The 2026-06 estimated primary completion date appears to relate to the phase 1b part.
AstraZeneca update of 11 Sept 2026: SERENA-4 did not meet statistically significant PFS improvement, numerical improvement only; no HR given and none public yet.

TROPION-Lung12 was stopped early: Daiichi Sankyo FY2025 Q3 materials (30 Jan 2026) state recruitment was closed in Dec 2025 "due to operational complexity" with 24-25 patients enrolled of 660 planned, so no primary DFS analysis is possible. Registry still says active, not recruiting; no AstraZeneca release found.

First disclosure is a Hengrui announcement of 29 Jan 2026 (Chinese) that the NMPA accepted the filing, stating the interim analysis showed significant BIRC-PFS improvement; this is 6 months before the registry estimated primary completion. HR was presented at ASCO 2026 (abstract 4001, CARES-336) around 1 June 2026; the earliest source I opened with the HR is dated 16 June, so hr_first_public_date is late by 2-4 weeks.

Daiichi Sankyo / AstraZeneca release of 3 Mar 2025: DESTINY-Gastric04 met OS at a planned interim analysis and was unblinded, no numbers. HR first public on 31 May 2025 (ASCO LBA and simultaneous NEJM). Registry still carries an estimated primary completion of 2026-08-31, 18 months after the readout.

No result found by NCT, 9MW2821-2023-CP301, bulumtatug fuvedotin or Chinese names; Mabwell investor materials in 2026 (seen in search summaries only) say an interim analysis of the monotherapy urothelial phase 3 is planned for H2 2026. Registry record last updated Apr 2025.

No result found by NCT, JMT101-018 or becotatug; trial only started in late 2024 and is listed as recruiting. The positive CSPC phase 3 announcement for JMT101 plus osimertinib concerns a different trial (EGFR exon 20, NCT06380348).
